description: Code mixing naming conventions such as camelCase and snake_case inconsistently

_calibration.note: Range raised to the fixture's true defect count. Grouped per the agent's Phase 3 rules, the fixture holds 8 warning-level findings: (1) booleans missing is/has prefix: active, enabled, debugMode; (2) abbreviations: Mgr, Acct, rm, Cfg/loadCfg, db; inconsistent naming, one per concept: (3) User/member/account entity, (4) name/memberName, (5) email/contactEmail, (6) id/accountId, (7) active/enabled; (8) vague checkUser. Optional suggestions (AccountInfo 'Info' suffix, lambda param 'a') can push the total to 10. Run 20261115T133150Z-naming-review-sonnet-high-06c1 measured 8-10 issues and 6-8 warnings across sonnet/high, haiku/high and opus/high; 3-7/2-5 undercounted.
